statement: A third-party ControlDeck project reports that a read-only USB HID feature report 0x12 request succeeded against a physical DualShock 4 v2, product 0x09CC, on macOS, yielding a 16-byte response. The reported layout places the controller identity in positions 1 through 6 and the stored peer identity in positions 10 through 15, each little-endian. This is a source-supported report of an external observation, not a measurement by this corpus. It does not establish behavior for v1, the wireless adapter, other firmware, or any pairing write.

applicability.revision: ControlDeck 46151468605ba4d9e5c6378079bb56cd3c934333, reported physical DS4 v2 USB product 0x09CC only
applicability.firmware: unknown; no version established in the cited report
applicability.scope: Externally reported read-only macOS IOHIDDeviceGetReport feature 0x12 result and positional structure; physical verification not performed by the corpus; no private identity or pairing data published.
